# 131. Nvidias skandal, börsens comeback och Sveriges finanssuccé

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-11-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode opens with the Nvidia scandal around Jensen Huang: a reported affair, suspected proxy-company chip sales to China and the key-man risk this exposes, with Dan Ives cited as saying the stock should fall 25% if Huang leaves. The hosts also cover the choppy week on the stock market and the rebound to all-time highs, which they link to a weakened Trump after the midterms and lower oil prices. They discuss strong Nordic reports (New Wave, Scandic, Munters), a CoreWeave-led easing of AI worries, rumours that the Investor sphere could buy Avanza, a growing deal pipeline before year-end, and London's decline as Stockholm gains as a financial centre. Rising US rates and a possible 50bp Fed hike are flagged as the main headwind.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

CEO scandal, China proxy-sales suspicion and succession probe; Dan Ives cites a 25% downside if Huang leaves.

#### Reasoning

The hosts stress key-man risk: Nvidia depends heavily on Huang, a board probe into successors has been reported, and betting markets put his exit at 50%. A second affair and the suspected chip smuggling to China via a proxy could threaten earnings. The downside figure is Dan Ives's (a cited analyst), not the hosts' own view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Jensen Huang leaves
- if China export-control violations are confirmed
- if more scandals emerge

> *"Han säger att värdet på Nvidia ska vara nere 25 procent. om Jensen Wang slutar."*

---

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

11% sales growth in a flat region; strong report but the stock fell after guidance was toned down; key-man risk around Torsten Jansson.

#### Reasoning

The hosts praise execution and growth regardless of macro, but note the stock dropped after expectations were lowered on the conference call, and the company depends on its founder. Positive view of the business, no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Torsten Jansson leaves without a clear successor
- if growth stalls after the lowered expectations

> *"Hur kan man öka omsättningen med 11 procent i en region som inte riktigt växer särskilt mycket? Det tycker jag är väldigt imponerande."*

---

### 🟠 MTRS — Munters | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

New financial targets at the CMD; track record of delivery; benefits from data-centre/AI growth.

#### Reasoning

Both hosts are impressed by Munters' growth and say its delivery history makes the new targets credible. Data-centre demand, reinforced by CoreWeave's strong report, supports the case despite the CEO's departure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it misses the new CMD targets
- if AI/data-centre investment slows

> *"Munter känns som ett bolag som har levererat. Så det finns en tillit till målsättningen där."*

---

### 🟠 SHOT — Scandic Hotels | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Sales up 8% in a slow-growing region; seen as a bet on the Swedish economy.

#### Reasoning

The host sees Scandic as a proxy for strong Swedish macro and praises CEO Jens Mathiasen. Positive tone but no explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Swedish economy weakens
- if rising rates hit consumer demand

> *"Scandic känns väldigt mycket som ett bet på den svenska ekonomin, tycker jag själv."*

---

### 🟠 CRWV — CoreWeave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Strong report and the week's winner, but a $799m net loss, heavy debt and a new large loan.

#### Reasoning

The hosts disagree: one is upbeat about cash flow arriving earlier and strong guarantees; the other warns that the debt financing means AI worries could return soon. Mixed and speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if debt concerns resurface
- if cash-flow timing slips

> *"Det är fortsatt väldigt skuldfinansierat och det är nog lätt att se de här problemen och den här oron komma tillbaka igen ganska snart."*

---

### 🟠 AZA — Avanza | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Corridor talk that the Investor sphere could bid for Avanza.

#### Reasoning

This is speculative M&A rumour reported by the host. The hosts find it 'very tickling' and note that an Avanza challenger is hard to build. No confirmation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the takeover talk is denied
- if competition from Nordnet/Montrose erodes market share

> *"En affär som det pratas mycket om, spekuleras en del om, det är ju om Investor sfären ska köpa Avanza."*

---

### 🟠 SWED-A — Swedbank | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Nordic banks doing very well as rates rise; Swedbank called a stock machine.

#### Reasoning

Rising rates favour bank margins. The host singles out Swedbank's strong share performance. Momentum observation rather than an explicit call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall back
- if credit losses rise

> *"Vilken aktiemaskin Swedbank är."*

---

### ⛔ PDX — Paradox Interactive | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO and main owner Fredrik Wester steps down again; the stock has been flat for five years and is down 15% over a year.

#### Reasoning

The host says it does not feel like Paradox has really turned and that leaving now seems early; they question whether the clean-up is finished. Mild negative view.

> *"Det känns inte som att det verkligen har vänt i Paradox."*

---

### 🟠 HEM — Hemnet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The week's loser among larger companies; the turnaround is still tentative despite +5% over a month.

#### Reasoning

The host earlier wanted to ride the turnaround but admits the recovery is far from clear. Watch, not buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the turnaround fails to show in results

> *"det är fortfarande en trevande och långt ifrån tydlig återuppgång i det här bolaget."*

---

### 🟠 BALD-B — Balder | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Real estate has bounced and Balder appears to have bottomed; rising rates are a risk to the trend.

#### Reasoning

The hosts note a sector rotation into previously weak real estate but are unsure the trend will hold as rates head up again.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates keep rising
- if the bounce proves temporary

> *"Balder har ju liksom jackat ner någon slags botten och kommit upp."*
